name: anlide/hilos
description: Hilos v2 - High-performance cluster framework with lightweight daemon

scripts.install-deps: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli composer install
scripts.setup-env: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli php -r "require 'vendor/autoload.php'; \Hilos\Utils\Env::init(); echo '.env file initialized.';"
scripts.daemon-status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli php framework/src/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli php framework/src/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm hilos-cli php framework/src/Bootstrap/cli.php
